description: This file contains C# source code defining internal grain classes for testing stream lifecycle management in Orleans. It includes producer and consumer internal grains with methods for testing removal, deactivation, and consumer setup.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleProducerInternalGrain
classes.description: An internal grain class for testing stream producer lifecycle, including removal and deactivation.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleConsumerInternalGrain
classes.description: An internal grain class for testing stream consumer lifecycle, including setup of consumer observers.

methods.name: TestInternalRemoveProducer
methods.description: Removes a producer from a stream, with optional storage write.

methods.name: DoBadDeactivateNoClose
methods.description: Deactivates the grain without closing the stream, with optional storage write.

methods.name: TestBecomeConsumerSlim
methods.description: Sets up the grain as a stream consumer with a new observer.
